items: 10 Wooden cats, or 10 planks and 10 furs to make them
No pet following you or in your inventory
rec: Watermelon seeds to plant on Harmony for Hard Morytania Diary (3)

st.t: Cross the gangplank to Bill Teach's ship at Port Phasmatys and talk to him to travel to Mos Le'Harmless. Talk to Brother Tranquility near the dock, and keep talking to him on Harmony until the chat ends.

Leave the windmill and head north. Wear your fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus, pull the saradomin statue, then enter it. Plant the watermelon seeds in the patch first if you brought them for the Hard Morytania Diary.
Enter the water.
Repair the stairs to the east.
Climb up the stairs to the east.
Climb up the ladder.
Peer through the nearby peephole.
Return to Brother Tranquility.

i: No pet following you or in your inventory

st.t: Search the south west bookcase in the Edgeville Monastery.
Read the prayer book.
Wear your holy symbol and return to Harmony: take Bill Teach's ship from Port Phasmatys to Mos Le'Harmless, then talk to Brother Tranquility near the dock to be taken there.
Keep your holy symbol on. Inside the windmill on Harmony, long-press the prayer book and choose Recite prayer.
Talk to Brother Tranquility again.
In Fenkenstrain's Castle, go up either staircase, go through the metal gate into the jail cell in the middle of the room, and climb the ladder there. Talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain at the top.
Wear your Ring of Charos and keep it on for this section. Talk to Rufus in Canifis' food store.
Either buy 10 wooden cats from the G.E., or make them on a clockmaker's bench in your POH.
i: 10 Wooden cats, or 10 planks and 10 furs to make them

st.t: Return to Dr. Fenkenstrain and build the crate next to him.
Add a bottom to the crate.
Fill the crate next to Fenkenstrain with wooden cats.
Blow the wolf whistle.
Return to Dr. Fenkenstrain and place the shipping order on the crate..

i: 10 Wooden cats, or 10 planks and 10 furs to make them

st.t: Talk to Dr. Fenkenstrain in the Harmony Windmill basement.
Leave the windmill basement and wear your fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus. Go north to the shipwreck and search the locker on the ship for a fuse.
Climb the ship's ladder.
Take a tinderbox.
Take a keg.
Climb down the ship's ladder.
Use the keg on the church's door.
Use the fuse on the keg.
Light the fuse.
Kill sorebones in the church until you have a cranial clamp, brain tongs, 3 bell jars and 30 skull staples.
Return to Dr. Fenkenstrain in the Harmony Windmill basement.
Talk to Brother Tranquility on Harmony.
Enter the church, ready to fight Barrelchest. If after initially entering you leave then re-enter, the Barrelchest will get stuck and you can safespot it from the door.
Confront Migor.
Defeat the barrelchest. You can safespot it from the door if you leave and re-enter the instance.
Pick up the anchor the Barrelchest dropped, then talk to Brother Tranquility on Harmony to complete the quest.
